''See also: [[Ashwind continent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Ashwind]] is a vast continent characterized by diverse geography, ranging from northern reaches near the [[Trackless Sea]] to southern jungles. Its landscape includes deserts and eastern forests that were once the domain of [[dragons]]. A significant historical landmark located in its southern region is the [[Tower of Seven Moons]], an ancient monument that has endured numerous natural disasters and attacks. The continent's central area is known as [[Moongrave]], which serves as its heart and a critical location in conflicts involving [[Akura Malice]]. During certain events, the continent has been depicted as turning black and has been subject to the influence of the [[Silent King]], whose allegiance was signaled by millions of white lights across the land. The name of the continent is associated with [[wind]] and ash.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Ashwind]] continent is a land inhabited by [[dragons]] and contains the location known as [[Moongrave]]. Within its southern reaches lies the relic known as the [[Tower of Seven Moons]], an area also entered by the [[Wandering Titan]] as it moves into the southern jungles. Despite its features, the continent is viewed by many as a place from which people desire to escape to return to the [[Dreadgod]].}}
